summary: OPKO Health's wholly owned BioReference Health unit agreed to sell its clinical and anatomic pathology lab testing business—including women's health, urology, corrections and the proprietary 4Kscore prostate cancer test—to Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings (Labcorp) under an October 14, 2026 Asset Purchase Agreement. Labcorp pays $722 million cash at closing, subject to revenue-based adjustment, plus up to $150 million over ten years tied to 4Kscore sales. Closing requires HSR clearance and customary conditions, no financing condition, outside date April 14, 2027. Buyer owes a $28.88 million termination fee for antitrust-approval failure. Watch HSR review and revenue-adjustment mechanics.
